segments.name: Biopharmaceutical
segments.description: A clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company developing injectable therapeutics that selectively modulate disease-specific T cells for autoimmune and inflammatory diseases.
segments.evidence: The Company operates as a single reporting segment, focused on developing a novel class of therapeutic biologics to selectively modulate disease-specific T cells directly within the patient's body.

revenueModel.text: The company earns revenue from collaboration and license agreements, as none of its drug product candidates have yet been approved for commercial sale.
revenueModel.evidence: all the Company's revenues since inception have been earned from collaboration agreements as none of the Company's drug product candidates have yet been approved for commercial sale.
